scope_notes: Single read-only audit pass; no periodic monitor. The two requested calls are audited even if subsequent calls begin while local evidence is being read.
Frozen source and final materialized input hashes are separate and both checked. Only cores=4 was program-added for these inputs; other controls already existed in source.
Both internal executions share the Python parent container. Cgroup CPU/memory samples are aggregate observations and must not be added to parent usage or to each other as independent totals.
Native admission and SDK actual-condition return are exercised. Direct top-level native source-consumption qualification is not exercised by these Python SDK calls.
This is not whole-task completion, scientific qualification, or an independent numerical/geometry reference. Output termination/convergence markers are raw observations only.
Resource samples are incomplete; absence of a collection error and matched archived files do not establish complete monetary/resource cost.

calls.route: Python SDK internal ORCA through native-orca-input-3; not a direct top-level orca.run Attempt
calls.source_text:
! r2SCAN-3c RKS Opt NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%scf
  MaxIter 256
  AutoTRAH false
end
%geom
  MaxIter 128
  Constraints
    {D 0 1 2 3 -180.0 C}
  end
end
* xyzfile 0 1 butane_initial.xyz
calls.final_text:
%pal nprocs 4 end
! r2SCAN-3c RKS Opt NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%scf
MaxIter 256
AutoTRAH false
end
%geom
MaxIter 128
Constraints
{D 0 1 2 3 -180.0 C}
end
end
* xyzfile 0 1 butane_initial.xyz
